newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums ease, demand stale.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums ease, demand stale.

text.p: Stagnant demand pushed NWE jet fuel cargo premiums notionally lower on Wednesday but those for barges were steady on fairly tight supply, traders said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures fell $3.25 cents to $218.75 a tonne, moving deeper into the red on the back of weaker NYMEX crude.

Cargoes were assessed at Jan IPE +28/29, around $1.50 lower, dipping on persistent lack of buying interest. Barges were stable at Jan IPE +$25. Traders said that without buyers there was no possibility of fixing the trans-Atlantic cargoes that remain available for NWE.
